title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2611.28732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive object

translated_title: Entangle：跨未见任务与上下文扩展人类视频上下文世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）使基础模型能够在不进行参数更新的情况下，根据上下文执行未见过的任务。在机器人操作中，人类视频提供了规定任务应如何执行的上下文。然而，在世界-动作模型（WAM）上扩展人类视频上下文学习面临两大挑战：任务级的人-机器人视频对与机器人动作在时间上不对齐，且标准动作损失使策略能够依赖初始场景或任务身份的捷径，而不是真正跟踪上下文。我们提出了Entangle，一种上下文世界-动作模型，它将单个人类视频和当前机器人观测映射到未来视觉状态和可执行动作。为了扩展时间对齐的训练数据，我们通过视频到视频生成技术将录制的机器人视频转换为匹配的人类上下文，并辅以真实的成对录制数据。在模型训练方面，我们结合了可变长度视频窗口与任务内对比物体（学习）...
tldr: Entangle提出了一种上下文世界-动作模型，通过视频到视频生成技术解决人-机器人数据时间对齐难题，并结合可变长度视频窗口与任务内对比学习防止捷径依赖，使机器人能够仅凭单个人类演示视频执行未见过的任务。
